translations.web: But to him who doesn’t work, but believes in him who justifies the ungodly, his faith is accounted for righteousness.
translations.bsb: However, to the one who does not work, but believes in Him who justifies the ungodly, his faith is credited as righteousness.
translations.kjv: But to him that worketh not, but believeth on him that justifieth the ungodly, his faith is counted for righteousness.
translations.asv: But to him that worketh not, but believeth on him that justifieth the ungodly, his faith is reckoned for righteousness.
